title: Seeing Through VisualBERT: A Causal Adventure on Memetic Landscapes

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting top causal concepts using Representation-based Individual Treatment Effect (RITE) scores and analyzing whether specific religious terms (e.g., 'Mohammed', 'jew') spuriously trigger offensive classifications due to dataset imbalances.

Qualitative error analysis evaluating whether visual or textual indicators of race (e.g., the concept of 'blackness') disproportionately drive offensive classifications by inspecting the top causal concepts extracted via the proposed Structural Causal Model (SCM) framework.
